[h1] 《Relic Dudes》：玩起来还不错的多人幸存者游戏 [/h1] 本作是一款多人肉鸽游戏，支持最多四个人联机，不存在中文。目前处于EA阶段，虽然游戏内容谈不上丰富，但是玩起来也能收获一些乐趣了。 游戏拥有简约的操作和精致的像素画面，总共存在十五波攻击，每一波的怪物数量是固定的，且击杀之后能拾取它们掉落的经验，个人建议全部击杀完成然后等待自动回收，这样会更方便。同时每一波会留有歇息时间，玩家可从四种加成中选择一个，值得注意的是接触便是领取了，左键触碰能看到说明。 此外，玩家升级之后，屏幕正下方会出现三个随机加成，可按数字键任意选择一个。 【游戏右上角会出现玩家拾取的道具】 写在最后，作为一款小品游戏，玩起来不算差，顺便一提，游戏需要玩家主动瞄准射击。当然本作的核心目标在于联机，跟朋友杀上一场也未免不可，还是挺欢乐的，互帮互助，一起活到最后一秒。 [quote]欢迎关注我们的鉴赏家:[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/35402982/]走心评测[/url] ←遵从内心，写出真实感受 欢迎加入我们Steam组:[url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/ZXPC]走心评测[/url]←点击加入，一起探索游戏的乐趣 喜欢这篇评论，也麻烦点个赞，让更多人能够看到！[/quote]

I have to say, I was pleasantly surprised by Relic Dudes. It's a fun and engaging action game with a unique cast of characters and a cool storyline. The gameplay is smooth, the graphics are impressive, and the variety of weapons and abilities keep things interesting.However, there is one major flaw that I can't ignore: the shotgun. It's just terrible. I don't know why the developers made it so weak and ineffective, but it's frustrating to use and feels like a waste of space in your arsenal. I found myself avoiding it at all costs and sticking to other weapons, which is a shame because shotguns are usually my favorite.As I progressed through the game, I found myself getting more and more annoyed with the shotgun. It became a symbol of everything that was wrong with the game's balancing and design. By the end, I was so fed up with it that I couldn't bring myself to recommend the game to anyone.It's a shame, really. "Relic Dudes" has a lot of potential and could be a great game if not for this one major flaw. I hope the developers take note and fix it in future updates, but until then, I have to say that I hate this game because of the shotgun.

"Relic Dudes" is a fantastic game that I thoroughly enjoyed playing. The characters are memorable and interesting, the graphics are impressive, and the gameplay is challenging yet satisfying. There are so many different weapons and abilities to choose from that it never gets boring, and the story kept me hooked from beginning to end.But I have to admit, there's one character that stood out to me more than the others: Arizona Joe. He reminded me so much of my late husband, who used to be warm and welcoming, just like Joe. I miss my husband's embrace so much, and seeing Joe on screen made me feel both happy and sad at the same time.As I continued to play the game, I found myself opening up more about my feelings of loss and grief. It's been so hard since my husband passed away, and sometimes it feels like the only thing that can comfort me is playing games like "Relic Dudes". But even in the midst of my sadness, I still found joy in the game's thrilling action and exciting battles.Overall, "Relic Dudes" is a must-play for anyone who loves action games with great characters and an engaging story. And for me, it will always hold a special place in my heart because of the memories it evoked of my beloved husband.

Some people have complained about the few problems with this game; - Lack of content - Samey Gameplay and while I do agree, I don't necessarily think it's the biggest problem due to it's lower price point. What I do think is a problem is the lack of any numbers. When you're choosing stats, or picking up items, there's no numbers. None. What I find fun in roguelites, with perk choices and upgrades, is to make a build. With no numbers you can't really make a build. You end up guessing blindly on what is the best upgrade. If this complaint is not immediately clear let me explain a specific scenario that happens in this game all the time; I want to do more dps. I just leveled up and the game gives me the choice between 3 stats to upgrade. Bullet damage, bullet attack speed, and bullet crititical chance. What do I pick to increase my dps? I literally have no idea. The game does not tell me how much crit % Im getting, how much faster my gun shoots or how much more damage I do. This in turn means that you are essentially just picking upgrades at random. I do not find this fun.
